currentRoundInspection.scope: Four useful actually inspected exterior/entry/detail pictures and normal viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.author: Yair Haklai
pictures.observed: Inspected complete960×939 seaward facade. Three tall upper round-headed windows,two lower screen windows and a central blind arched panel;heavy stone pilasters/continuous ledges,curved lead pediment roof,four decorated corner pinnacles,grey dome/gold finial and two slender single-balcony minarets. Quay/ticket booths are surroundings,not copied model parts.

pictures.author: R Prazeres
pictures.observed: Inspected complete960×720 entrance view. U-shaped two-storey rear wings enclose a pink/cream courtyard elevation with three round arch transoms;central timber entry and flanking screen gates under stone lintels/pilasters. The high curved pediment and medallion pinnacles rise behind. Fine gilt grille/calligraphy and temporary banners are omitted.

pictures.author: R Prazeres
pictures.observed: Inspected complete960×1127 SW facade detail. Shallow grey dome,curved sloping lead roof bands,high corner medallion panels on stepped pilasters and gold finials;round upper window heads and strong continuous cornices. Geometry approximates large relief masses and round medallions;no copied sculpted patterns.

pictures.author: Joseolgon
pictures.observed: Inspected960×640 overall daylight view. Small square prayer hall with grey dome,arched side facade and low rear wings;two very tall pale single-balcony minarets with slender segmented grey caps. The mosque sits immediately at the Bosphorus edge. Bridge,city buildings,boats and waterfront businesses remain host content.
